title: Sustainable Corn CAP: Arlington historical plot-year grain yields

rights.review_scope: Exact CC0 article v1 workbook, native grain-yield cells, plot identifiers and their in-workbook descriptions only. No linked papers, weather services, logos, portal tools or third-party assets.
rights.portal_terms_review: Dataset citation is requested; contact/coauthorship is encouraged, not required. No ownership of publisher intellectual property is claimed. This intake uses the CC0 Ag Data Commons workbook, not portal exports.
rights.attribution: Abendroth, Lori J. et al. (2017). Sustainable Corn CAP Research Data (USDA-NIFA Award No. 2011-68002-30190). National Agricultural Library - ARS - USDA. DOI 10.15482/USDA.ADC/1411953.

selection.selection_basis: One explicitly bounded research site with all source plot-year grain-yield rows, selected before constructing any evaluation question. Not a representative sample of the full dataset or independent farms.

admission.required_before_product_admission: Separate source-specific domain/mapping review and runtime policy decision. Native study observations cannot establish a current farmer-field outcome, treatment effect, recommendation or local calibration.

limits: Historical research data from 2011-2015; publisher posting/modification dates do not refresh the observations.
18 repeated experimental plots at one site, not 18 or 90 independent farms.
Source moisture-adjusted grain-yield measurements are retained without rescaling, imputation or causal interpretation. Blank cells remain missing; zero remains zero.
Plot treatment codes are native categories, not current management instructions; no fertilizer rates or field-operation joins are admitted.
No geometry, weather, soil, pesticide, economic or greenhouse-gas measurements are imported. ARL soil notes flag suspect 2015 values and different sampling depths.
Trend questions must compare the same crop and preserve sample counts, years and plot dependence. Descriptive row means are not causal effects or farmer-field predictions.
This exposed development source is unsuitable for a claim of untouched holdout evaluation without the evaluation owner's separate split and leakage review.
